metrics.name: 好友房｜设备七日留存率
metrics.alias: 新增设备七日留存率、设备第七日留存、设备7日留存、设备D7留存、运营总表设备留存
metrics.business_definition: 以friend_ods.cell_mac_info.first_open_date当日首次激活的去重mac为新增设备人群，分子为这些设备在首次激活日加6日有friend_ods.app_login_log登录记录的去重mac数，分母为该首次激活日的新增设备去重mac数。与运营总表对齐时，日期为回访日，首次激活日=报表日期减6日；按首次激活日展示须明确平移日期轴。只计算已完整结束的回访日；返回0—1比例，展示乘100%。产品pid、渠道agent_id筛选取首次激活记录；登录仅按mac匹配，不额外限定回访渠道。不能替代为活跃设备回访率、账号留存、金币房留存或连续7日登录率。分母无设备时为NULL，跨日和跨维度汇总须从明细重新去重。
metrics.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(first_open_date) AS cohort_date, mac
  FROM friend_ods.cell_mac_info
  WHERE first_open_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 36 DAY)
    AND first_open_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
), visits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(login_date) AS visit_date, mac
  FROM friend_ods.app_login_log
  WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()
)
SELECT DATE_ADD(c.cohort_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS dt,
       c.cohort_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.mac) AS new_device_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.mac) AS retained_device_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.mac) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.mac), 0) AS metric_value
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.mac = c.mac
  AND v.visit_date = DATE_ADD(c.cohort_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
GROUP BY c.cohort_date;

metrics.name: 金币房｜金币余额分位数
metrics.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT DATE(login_date) dt,user_id,money,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE(login_date),user_id ORDER BY login_date DESC,id DESC) rn FROM gold_ods.app_login_log WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,user_id,money FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,0.1 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.1) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.25 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.25) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.5 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.5) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.7 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.7) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.85 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.85) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.95 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.95) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.99 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.99) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt;
metrics.definition: 对用户日最后一条登录余额 `money` 计算近似第十、第二十五、第五十、第七十、八十五、九十五、九十九百分位。 使用 `approx_percentile`；产品总体从映射渠道用户明细重新计算，全局总体从全部用户明细重新计算。分位数不得跨渠道直接相加或取平均。 单位：金币。
metrics.risk: 无来源记录不补0；人数/比例跨渠道与跨日须从明细重算。

metrics.sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),ranked AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,m.end_num,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC) rn FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.user_money_log m ON m.user_id=c.user_id AND m.prop_id=1 AND m.log_date>=c.observed_dt AND m.log_date<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,observation_day,user_id,end_num FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,observation_day,0.15 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.15) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.35 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.35) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.55 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.55) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.75 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.75) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.95 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.95) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

metrics.sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),per_user AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,SUM(g.game_time) game_seconds,MAX(CASE WHEN g.result_money>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won,MAX(CASE WHEN g.begin_money+g.result_money-g.num_8=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) broke FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.log_time>=c.observed_dt AND g.log_time<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND g.game_time>0 GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id) SELECT dt,observation_day,AVG(broke*1.0) metric_value FROM per_user GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

  AND (order_status=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date)), denominator AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value

SELECT d.dt, 1*n.metric_value/NULLIF(d.metric_value,0) AS metric_value
FROM denominator d LEFT JOIN numerator n ON n.dt=d.dt;

metrics.name: 好友房｜付费账号平均充值金额
metrics.sql:
WITH numerator AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, SUM(infull_amount)/100.0 AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date)), denominator AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date))
SELECT d.dt, 1*n.metric_value/NULLIF(d.metric_value,0) AS metric_value
FROM denominator d LEFT JOIN numerator n ON n.dt=d.dt;

metrics.sql:
WITH numerator AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date)), denominator AS (SELECT DATE(login_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.app_login_log
WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY DATE(login_date))
SELECT d.dt, 1*n.metric_value/NULLIF(d.metric_value,0) AS metric_value
FROM denominator d LEFT JOIN numerator n ON n.dt=d.dt;

只保留 package_log 一路原流水，记录前后余额、prop_num、amount 与操作原码。

-- 示例 start_date=2026-11-02 00:00:00，end_date=2026-11-03 00:00:00。
-- 其他调度参数：snapshot_date=实际采集日，history_start_date=快照建设首日，data_complete_before=验收水位。
WITH card_props AS (
  SELECT prop_id, prop_type
  FROM friend_ods.prop_info
  WHERE prop_type=1
), raw_flow AS (
  SELECT id, user_id, type, amount, prop_id, begin_num, end_num, prop_num,
         log_date, order_no, if_agent, card_from_user_id, card_from_type, pid
  FROM friend_ods.package_log
  WHERE log_date >= '${start_date}' AND log_date < '${end_date}'
)
SELECT f.id AS flow_id, f.log_date AS event_time, DATE(f.log_date) AS event_date,
       f.user_id, 'friend' AS account_domain, f.if_agent AS account_type_raw,
       f.pid, f.prop_id, f.begin_num AS before_qty_raw,
       f.end_num AS after_qty_raw, f.prop_num AS prop_qty_raw,
       f.end_num-f.begin_num AS balance_delta_raw, f.amount AS amount_raw,
       f.type AS operation_type_raw, f.card_from_type AS card_from_type_raw,
       f.card_from_user_id AS counterparty_user_id, f.order_no,
       'unknown' AS qty_unit, 'unknown' AS operation_category,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS delta_qty,
       CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS is_internal_transfer,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS correction_ref,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS mapping_version, 0 AS mapping_confirmed
FROM raw_flow f JOIN card_props p ON f.prop_id=p.prop_id;
prerequisites: 查清 change_log_type_config 中 function_type=1 的类型字典及历史变化，确认系统发放、游戏消耗、内部转移、退回、冲正的映射。
验收数量单位、正负号、prop_num 与余额差的关系；验收前不产出标准 delta_qty。当前 prop_info 字典未证明历史房卡覆盖完整。

models.title: 账号日登录付费汇总（保留支付全集）
models.grain: stat_date×account_domain×account_key；空账号支付按日保留对账桶，不计账号数
models.incremental: 从登录与成功支付DWD分别聚合账号日，合并账号全集；迟到、补单、状态修正重算受影响分区
rules: 登录、支付各自先聚合再关联，禁止明细多对多倍增。
保留仅付费未登录账号与空账号支付金额；财务总额和登录交集金额分别计算。
付费率、登录ARPU/ARPPU只用login_flag=1集合；空账号对账桶不计任何账号数。
logic_steps: 登录与成功支付分别从DWD聚合到账号日，不额外新建支付日表。
对两侧账号取并集，再分别关联日汇总；仅付费未登录账号也保留，防止漏收入或明细倍增。
空账号支付进入独立对账桶，保留金额但不计账号数；不能伪造为一个付费用户。
总成功金额汇总全部行；登录付费率及ARPU/ARPPU限定login_flag=1，分母分别为登录账号与登录付费账号。
models.sql:
-- 示例 start_date=2026-11-02 00:00:00，end_date=2026-11-03 00:00:00。
-- 其他调度参数：snapshot_date=实际采集日，history_start_date=快照建设首日，data_complete_before=验收水位。
WITH logged AS (
  SELECT login_date AS stat_date, account_domain, user_id,
         CONCAT('uid:',CAST(user_id AS CHAR)) AS account_key,
         COUNT(*) AS login_record_cnt
  FROM friend_dwd.dwd_friend_login_event_di
  WHERE login_date >= CAST('${start_date}' AS DATE)
    AND login_date < CAST('${end_date}' AS DATE) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY login_date, account_domain, user_id
), paid AS (
  SELECT success_date AS stat_date, account_domain, user_id,
         CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'null_uid_reconciliation'
              ELSE CONCAT('uid:',CAST(user_id AS CHAR)) END AS account_key,
         COUNT(*) AS success_order_cnt, SUM(amount_fen) AS success_amount_fen
  FROM friend_dwd.dwd_friend_pay_success_di
  WHERE success_date >= CAST('${start_date}' AS DATE)
    AND success_date < CAST('${end_date}' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY success_date, account_domain, user_id
), account_set AS (
  SELECT stat_date, account_domain, user_id, account_key FROM logged
  UNION
  SELECT stat_date, account_domain, user_id, account_key FROM paid
)
SELECT a.stat_date, a.account_domain, a.account_key, a.user_id,
       CASE WHEN a.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_identified_account,
       CASE WHEN l.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS login_flag,
       COALESCE(l.login_record_cnt,0) AS login_record_cnt,
       CASE WHEN a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND p.success_order_cnt>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pay_flag,
       COALESCE(p.success_order_cnt,0) AS success_order_cnt,
       CASE WHEN p.success_order_cnt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE p.success_amount_fen END AS success_amount_fen,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before
FROM account_set a LEFT JOIN logged l
  ON a.stat_date=l.stat_date AND a.account_domain=l.account_domain AND a.account_key=l.account_key
LEFT JOIN paid p
  ON a.stat_date=p.stat_date AND a.account_domain=p.account_domain AND a.account_key=p.account_key;

models.title: 登录分群留存汇总
models.incremental: 每日重算仍处于1/3/7日观察窗的分群，加迟到窗口；以任务验收水位确认成熟
rules: 未成熟分群的留存人数和比例为NULL，不当0。
分群属性按cohort日冻结；不能用今天的用户标签回写历史分群。
保存分子分母；跨分组重算比例，不平均留存率。
logic_steps: 复用现有DWS的 user_type=1，先去重到日×账号。
分别计算D+1、D+3、D+7精确回访，保存分群人数和留存人数。
需回访整日都早于验收水位才成熟；未成熟人数为NULL，不当0。
models.sql:
-- 示例 start_date=2026-11-02 00:00:00，end_date=2026-11-03 00:00:00。
-- 其他调度参数：snapshot_date=实际采集日，history_start_date=快照建设首日，data_complete_before=验收水位。
WITH login_days AS (
  SELECT DATE(dt) AS stat_date, user_id
  FROM friend_dws.user_app_login_daily_d
  WHERE dt >= '${start_date}'
    AND dt < DATE_ADD('${end_date}', INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    AND user_type=1 AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE(dt), user_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT stat_date, user_id FROM login_days
  WHERE stat_date >= CAST('${start_date}' AS DATE)
    AND stat_date < CAST('${end_date}' AS DATE)
)
SELECT c.stat_date AS cohort_date, 'friend' AS account_domain,
       1 AS retention_days, COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 2 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME)
            THEN COUNT(r.user_id) ELSE NULL END AS retained_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 2 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mature,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS computed_at
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN login_days r
  ON c.user_id=r.user_id AND r.stat_date=DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY c.stat_date
UNION ALL
SELECT c.stat_date AS cohort_date, 'friend' AS account_domain,
       3 AS retention_days, COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 4 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME)
            THEN COUNT(r.user_id) ELSE NULL END AS retained_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 4 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mature,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS computed_at
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN login_days r
  ON c.user_id=r.user_id AND r.stat_date=DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 3 DAY)
GROUP BY c.stat_date
UNION ALL
SELECT c.stat_date AS cohort_date, 'friend' AS account_domain,
       7 AS retention_days, COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME)
            THEN COUNT(r.user_id) ELSE NULL END AS retained_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mature,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS computed_at
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN login_days r
  ON c.user_id=r.user_id AND r.stat_date=DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY c.stat_date;
